audit: v077 navigation / bounded isolated production-method simulation

method.note: Stationary goals, no shooting/immune cells/deaths; private methods called in a bundled isolated fixture. This tests reachability and spawn legality, not fun or ordinary run balance.

spatialUse.note: Endless spawns follow the player, but all tissue repair / pulse facilities remain in the center and there are no peripheral objectives. Available area does not itself create a reason to visit the perimeter.
